messages:
Rae (PM): Throwing out a proposal: a 'soft-onboard' lane for low-risk catalog entries. Purpose: faster time-to-catalog while keeping bench + pin safety nets. Short smoke + constrained canary + tenant opt-in pin. Feedback?
Noah (Platform Eng): Agree if we lock hardware and autoscale floor. Also want an infra 'hold' flag to instantly stop rollouts. Will need a canary job template.
Yuki (ML Research): Bench suggestion: p95 latency <= 130ms, eval AUC >= 0.90 vs stable, cost multiplier <= 1.2x, tokenization parity <= 2%. Add 12 human spot-checks for semantics.
Fiona (CS): Customers want clear pin expectations. Recommend tenant opt-in, default TTL 60 days, auto-renew off, and a "smooth-unpin" 14-day ramp checklist in the Console.
Liam (Sales): I'll draft a one-liner for AEs: "60-day enterprise pin available; extensions require contract." Will run it past legal.
Deploy-bot: Created job soft-onboard-canary-v1. Regions: us-west-2, eu-west-1. Alerts: latency_p95_exceed, error_rate_spike, infra_incident. Dashboard: /dash/soft-onboard-v1.
Rae (PM): Minimal flow sketch (wip):
```
flow: soft_onboard_v1
smoke_hours: 48
canary_days: 10
canary_traffic_pct: 5
hardware_tags: [g5.xlarge]
bench_gates: {latency_p95_ms:130, eval_auc_min:0.90, cost_mult_max:1.2, token_parity_pct:2}
pin: {tenant_opt_in:true, default_ttl_days:60, auto_renew:false, escape: rollback-to-stable}
owners: [Rae, Noah, Yuki, Fiona]
```
Noah (Platform Eng): I'll add autoscale floor, hardware pin enforcement, and the hold flag to the infra job. ETA: Fri.
Yuki (ML Research): Running baseline bench today; will post results and the human spot-check matrix here.
Fiona (CS): I'll draft the migration checklist + Console copy and add per-tenant adoption telemetry. Draft by Mon.
Liam (Sales): AE blurb to legal now. ETA Tues.
Rae (PM): Sign-off rule: PM + Eng lead + ML + CS. Any veto pauses full catalog entry. Action items assigned; scheduling a 20m review next Wed. :thumbsup:
